title: Meadow's fonts served by the app, text one pixel bigger everywhere, and DCLab Code's own logo as the app icon
request: Owner: download Outfit and Plus Jakarta Sans into the app and use them as the Meadow kit does; make the font a little bigger everywhere; add a logo as the app's icon.
spec: dclab-code web/style.css, web/fonts/, web/logo.svg, scripts/make-icon.js, mac/build.sh
plan: the two variable fonts from Fontsource on npm (archives only, nothing installed or run), Latin and extended Latin, with their licences
@font-face rules with the packages' own character ranges
every font size and the terminal's up one pixel
a logo in Meadow's style; the sidebar, the tab icon and the Mac icon from one SVG
the icon built by a script, the build copying it in

decisions.decision: the fonts are files in the app, not a link to Google Fonts
decisions.why: the app's content policy allows only its own fonts, and it works offline

decisions.decision: a new mark (blue square, lime pulse) instead of the Flowscope icon found on the Mac
decisions.why: that icon is another product's; DCLab Code gets its own in the same kit's style

decisions.decision: the icon added to the installed app in place (the same file and Info.plist key the build now adds), not a rebuild
decisions.why: a store job was running in the app's R&D server; quitting would have interrupted it

decisions.decision: the icon is rendered by Chromium with a transparent ground
decisions.why: the quick-look renderer painted the corners white, which the Dock would show as a white square

change: dclab-code: web/fonts/ (4 woff2, 2 OFL licences), web/style.css (@font-face, sizes, the sidebar mark), web/app.js (terminal 13 px), web/logo.svg, web/logo-mark.svg, web/index.html (tab icon), scripts/make-icon.js, mac/AppIcon.icns, mac/build.sh.

findings.defect: the first icon render had white opaque corners
findings.scenario: qlmanage's thumbnail of the SVG: corner pixel (255,255,255,255)
findings.test: corner pixel (0,0,0,0) in the built icns

measurements.name: fonts load
measurements.gate: both faces loaded in the page
measurements.result: Outfit 100-900 and Plus Jakarta Sans 200-800 loaded; body 15 px

measurements.name: build
measurements.gate: the build script makes a signed app with the icon
measurements.result: a scratch build: Resources/AppIcon.icns, CFBundleIconFile AppIcon, codesign verified

outcome: The app reads in Meadow's own faces at a slightly bigger size and carries its own logo in the sidebar, the tab and the Dock.
lessons: Check an icon's corner pixels: a renderer's white ground looks right on a white page and wrong in the Dock.
risks: the Dock shows the new icon only after the app is opened again
